cards.name: Southron Archer
cards.text:
Archery 2.
Forced: After Southron Archer engages you, either remove 2 progress tokens from the main quest, or discard an ally you control.

cards.name: Shadowy Vale
cards.text: While any player has threat of 35 or higher, Shadowy Vale gets +3 [threat]. Forced: After Shadowy Vale becomes the active location, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Poros Garrison
cards.text: The last player gains control of Poros Garrison. Immune to player card effects. You can optionally engage an additional enemy during the encounter phase. If Poros Garrison leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Desert Oasis
cards.text: While Desert Oasis is the active location, it gains: "Response: When Desert Oasis is explored, heal 4 damage from among characters in play."Forced: After Desert Oasis becomes the active location, each player exhausts a character he controls.

cards.name: Desert Warg
cards.text: When Revealed: Either place a random enemy from the set aside Desert Creatures set in the encounter discard pile, or Desert Warg gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Uruk Chieftain
cards.text: Cannot have player card attachments or be optionally engaged.While the engaged player is engaged with another Orc enemy, Uruk Chieftain cannot take damage.Forced: At the end of the encounter phase, Uruk Chieftain engages the player engaged with the most non-unique Orc enemies.

cards.name: Mordor Warg
cards.text: When Revealed: Attach to an Orc enemy and return that enemy to the staging area. Limit 1 per enemy. (Counts as a Mount attachment with the text: "Attached enemy gets +2 [threat], +2 [attack], +2 [defense] and +2 hit points. Forced: When attached enemy leaves play, add Mordor Warg to the staging area.")

cards.name: Southron Pursuit
cards.text: When Revealed: Set each other stage 3A aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the Harad Soldiers encounter set into the encounter deck. Then, each player reveals an encounter card.
cards.back_text: Each enemy in the staging area gets -10 engagement cost. Forced: After an enemy engages a player, remove 1 progress from this stage.

cards.name: Harondor Waste
cards.text: Forced: After Harondor Waste becomes the active location, choose 1 random card from the set aside encounter set with the most cards remaining and place it in the encounter discard pile. Then, shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.

cards.name: Orc Patrols
cards.text: When Revealed: Set each other stage 3A aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the Mordor Orcs encounter set into the encounter deck. Then, each player reveals an encounter card.
cards.back_text: Orc Patrols gets +2 quest point for each enemy in the staging area. Forced: After an enemy engages a player, raise that player's threat by 1.

cards.name: Nowhere to Hide
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player discards cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded, and puts that enemy into play engaged with him.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if it was engaged this round).

cards.name: Deadly Creatures
cards.text: When Revealed: Set each other stage 3A aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the Desert Creatures encounter set into the encounter deck. Then, each player reveals an encounter card.
cards.back_text: Enemies in the staging area cannot take damage. Forced: After an enemy engages a player, deal 1 damage to a hero that player controls.

cards.name: Towering Dunes
cards.text: While Towering Dunes is in the staging area, progress cannot be placed on locations in the staging area not named Towering Dunes.Forced: After Towering Dunes becomes the active location, reveal the top card of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Battle at the Crossings
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player takes control of Poros Garrison. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for each enemy that belongs to an encounter set denoted by the first icon on each set aside stage 3 and add them to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Forced: After an enemy attacks and destroys a character, remove X progress from this stage. X is the attacking enemy's printed [threat]. This stage cannot be defeated except at the end of the combat phase. If the players defeat this stage, they win the game.

cards.name: Southron Outrider
cards.text: Forced: After Southron Outrider engages you, either place a random enemy from the Harad Soldiers set in the encounter discard pile, or Southron Outrider gets +3 [attack] this round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Exhaust a character you control.

cards.name: Southron Champion
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a Harad enemy is discarded. Add that enemy to the staging area and place a resource token on it. That enemy is "the Champion." While this stage is in play, the Champion gets +2 [threat], +2 [attack], +2 [defense] and gains: "Immune to player card effects. The main quest stage cannot be defeated while the Champion is in play." The champion cannot take damage unless there are at least 4 progress tokens here. This stage cannot be defeated while the champion is in play.

cards.name: Southron Captain
cards.text: While Southron Captain is in the staging area, each other Harad enemy gets +1 [threat].While Southron Captain is engaged with you, each other Harad enemy engaged with you gets +1 [attack].

cards.name: Craft Remedy
cards.text: Treat the printed text box of each damaged character as if it were blank (except for Traits). Response: When this is defeated, heal 1 damage from each character in play.

cards.name: The Black Serpent
cards.text: Cannot leave the staging area or take damage. X is the stage number of the main quest. The Black Serpent gets +X [threat], +X [attack] and +X [defense]. Forced: At the end of the encounter phase, either remove X progress from the main quest, or The Black Serpent makes an immediate attack against the first player.

cards.name: The Ephel Duath
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the Mountains of Shadow encounter set into the encounter deck. Remove the Desert Sands encounter set and the other stage 2A from the game.
cards.back_text: Forced: After a player plays an ally, he must either exhaust that ally or raise his threat by 1. Forced: When this stage is defeated, advance to a random stage 3.

cards.name: Find a Way Down
cards.text: The path through the hills has led you too far up and now you walk along exposed heights where there's nowhere to hide. You need to find a way down. Surge. Each player's threat cannot be reduced. Response: When Find a Way Down is defeated, each player reduces his threat by 3.

cards.name: Giant Scorpion
cards.text: Forced: After Giant Scorpion damages a character, that character cannot ready until the end of the round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack deals damage, the defending character cannot ready until the end of the round.

cards.name: Foothills of Mordor
cards.text: While Foothills of Mordor is in the staging area, 'when revealed' effects cannot be canceled. Forced: After Foothills of Mordor becomes the active location, raise each player's threat by 2.

cards.name: Southron Soldier
cards.text: Forced: After Southron Soldier engages you, either remove 2 progress tokens from the main quest, or Southron Soldier makes an immediate attack.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Choose an enemy in the staging area. Engage it and deal it a shadow card.

cards.name: Heat Exhaustion
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player exhausts a character he controls and deals 1 damage to that character.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Exhaust a character you control.

cards.name: Mountains of Shadow
cards.text: When Revealed: Raise each player's threat by X, where X is the printed quest points of the active location. If there is no active location, Mountains of Shadow gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys a character, raise your threat by 2.

cards.name: Sandstorm
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player either discards his hand, or assigns X damage among characters he controls. X is the number of cards in his hand.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Either discard the highest cost attachment you control, or assign X damage among characters you control where X is the number of attachments you control.

cards.name: Desolate Land
cards.text: X is the highest number of characters controlled by a single player. Forced: After Desolate Land becomes the active location, choose 1 random card from the set aside encounter set with the most cards remaining. Reveal that card as if it was part of the encounter deck.

cards.name: Danger Close Behind
cards.text:
Doomed 1.
When Revealed: Choose 1 random card from the set aside encounter set with the most cards remaining. Reveal that card as if it was the top card of the encounter deck.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, resolve the 'when revealed' effect on this card.

cards.name: Find Water
cards.text: Characters cannot be readied by player card effects. Response: When this stage is defeated, each player readies 1 hero he controls.

cards.name: Flight to Gondor
cards.text: Setup: Set Poros Garrison and each of the following encounter sets aside, out of play: Mountains of Shadow, Desert Sands, Desert Creatures, Harad Soldiers, and Mordor Orcs. The first player adds The Black Serpent to the staging area and shuffles the encounter deck. Each other player reveals an encounter card.
cards.back_text: Allies enter play exhausted. Forced: At the end of the planning phase, advance to a random stage 2.

cards.name: Uruk Prowler
cards.text: When Revealed: Either place a random enemy from the set aside Mordor Orcs set in the encounter discard pile, or Uruk Prowler makes an immediate attack against the first player.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Discard a random card from your hand.

cards.name: Uruks of the Eye
cards.text:
Surge.
Each Orc enemy in the staging area gets -5 engagement cost. Each Orc enemy engaged with a player gets +1 [threat].

cards.name: Uruk of Mordor
cards.text: Each ally with less [willpower] than Uruk of Mordor's [threat] cannot defend against Uruk of Mordor.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if its [threat] is greater than the defending character's [willpower]).

cards.name: Sand Viper
cards.text: Players cannot declare defenders against Sand Viper.Forced: After the players travel to a location, Sand Viper engages the first player.

cards.name: Fear of Mordor
cards.text: When Revealed: Each ally in play gets -1 [willpower], -1 [attack], and -1 [defense] until the end of the round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If attacking enemy's [threat] is greater than the defending character's [willpower], it makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: The Desert Path
cards.text: When Revealed: Shuffle the Desert Sands encounter set into the encounter deck. Remove the Mountains of Shadow encounter set and the other stage 2A from the game.
cards.back_text: Forced: After a player plays an ally, he must either exhaust that ally or deal 1 damage to it. Forced: When this stage is defeated, advance to a random stage 3.

cards.name: Uruk Warg-Rider
cards.text: Uruk Warg-Rider gets +X [attack] while attacking a character with less [willpower] than Uruk Warg-rider's [threat]. X is the difference.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Return attacking enemy to the staging area after this attack.
